description.from:
## Goal

Put **pilobil.us** on the public internet as a Markus static site, then hand Ryan the nameservers.

This was missing from the renderer initiative. PPY-5e8072 is visual design (local HTML). PPY-10e4cd is the two-renderer PoC (openable in a browser). PPY-6b4094 is an Amplify **sandbox** for the Papyrus newsroom app so `npm run build` / BDD have a backend. None of those ship pilobil.us.

## What CI/CD is today (do not cargo-cult the wrong one)

Papyrus **publication apps that are live today are Amplify SSR**, not a static Markus pipeline:

- **p.apyr.us** — Amplify app `Papyrus` (`dbsyytcm9drqa`), platform `WEB_COMPUTE`. `amplify.yml` runs `ampx pipeline-deploy` for the Gen 2 backend, then `next build` and ships `.next`. Production branch is `main`. Custom domain is Amplify-managed on the `apyr.us` Route 53 zone (`p.apyr.us` A-alias to CloudFront).
- **threat-intelligence.anth.us** — a **separate** Amplify `WEB_COMPUTE` app (`Threat Intelligence`, `d3on1y5vlrxmam`) pointed at `github.com/anthusai/threat-intelligence` (a Papyrus-branded checkout), domain on the `anth.us` zone.
- **Anth.us** marketing — Amplify platform `WEB` (static, not compute) at `github.com/AnthusAI/Anth.us`.
- **Markus demo** — GitHub Pages (`.github/workflows/pages.yml` → `anthusai.github.io/Markus/`). That is the only existing Markus static CI. It is not used for publications.

There is **no** CI/CD yet for a Markus-rendered publication site. The architecture decision on PPY-88f77b / PPY-92f846 is explicit: Markus emits static HTML and must **not** ride the Papyrus Amplify SSR `.next` pipeline. Preview and shipped output are the same files.

## Domain

Doctrine (`Pilobol.us/doctrine/pilobil.md`) says the live domain is **pilobil.us**. The git repo is `Pilobol.us` (the fungus). Confirm spelling before creating the zone if anything disagrees.

No Route 53 hosted zone for `pilobil.us` or `pilobol.us` exists in account `335163751677`. Other Anthus `*.us` properties (`apyr.us`, `anth.us`, `chattic.us`, `kanb.us`, …) already live in this account.

## Recommended shape

1. Create a Route 53 **public hosted zone** for `pilobil.us` in this account. Comment the NS records here so Ryan can set them at the registrar. Do this first so NS propagation runs in parallel with CI work.
2. Host the **static** `web/dist` (or equivalent Markus build output) — **not** Amplify `WEB_COMPUTE`, **not** the Papyrus app, **not** `ampx pipeline-deploy`.
3. Preferred host, matching other `*.us` properties in this account: **Amplify Hosting platform `WEB` (static)** on `AnthusAI/Pilobol.us`, custom build that runs the Markus static build (see leftover `web/build.py` on PPY-5e8072). Amplify then manages CloudFront + ACM; once the hosted zone exists, attach `pilobil.us` + `www`. This is the Anth.us pattern, not the p.apyr.us pattern.
4. Fallback if Amplify WEB fights a Python build: GitHub Actions → S3 + CloudFront, or GitHub Pages with Route 53 aliases (the Markus demo pattern). Say which you chose and why.
5. CI builds from repo-committed Markdown with `markus convert --allow-html` **off**. `markus validate` is not a security control.

## Constraints

- Do not deploy to or modify Papyrus production (`p.apyr.us` / Amplify app `dbsyytcm9drqa`).
- Do not put the Markus site on the Papyrus SSR app via `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND`.
- Do not touch `lib/renderer.ts` or `renderers/pretext/`.
- Record teardown for anything that is not the lasting hosted zone / production site.
- Do not close this issue yourself.

## Acceptance

- Hosted zone exists; NS records are in a Kanbus comment for Ryan.
- A push to the agreed branch publishes real Markus HTML to a reachable URL (Amplify default domain is fine until NS propagate).
- After Ryan sets nameservers and they propagate, `https://pilobil.us` serves that site.
- Working procedure written down (runnable doc).
description.to:
## Goal

Hosting is a **Papyrus site configuration option**, not a per-publication fork.

Pilobil.us is the first publication that *uses* the static option. It is not a special Papyrus checkout, not a second product repo in the Threat Intelligence shape (`github.com/anthusai/threat-intelligence` + its own Amplify `WEB_COMPUTE` app), and not a one-off README in the pod.

## Axes (do not collapse them)

Already decided: Renderer (`pretext` | `markus`) × Layout (Pretext-only: `newsprint` | `blog` | `magazine`) × Publication (the title).

Add **Hosting** as a sibling axis, documented in Papyrus:

```text
type HostingConfig =
  | { kind: "amplify-ssr" }      // Amplify platform WEB_COMPUTE. Next.js. GraphQL at request time. Content can change without rebuilding HTML.
  | { kind: "amplify-static" }   // Amplify platform WEB. Build emits a folder of HTML/CSS/assets. New copy = new build.
```

Leave the union open for later kinds (GitHub Pages, S3+CloudFront) without implementing them. Invalid combos can exist in theory (pretext + static is a poor fit today); document the intended pairings rather than inventing a fake static Pretext pipeline.

Intended pairings:
- **amplify-ssr** + pretext — p.apyr.us / Threat Intelligence today
- **amplify-static** + markus — pilobil.us, and any future Markus publication

## Papyrus deliverable (this is the point)

Document the option **in the Papyrus repo**, not only in the pod:

- A runnable hosting doc under `docs/` (new file, e.g. `docs/site-hosting.md`) that explains both kinds, when to choose which, Amplify platform values (`WEB` vs `WEB_COMPUTE`), what the build artifact is, custom domains / Route 53, and how a new publication opts in.
- A pointer from `AGENTS.md` so agents do not cargo-cult the SSR `amplify.yml` onto a Markus site.
- Any committed config/examples (sample `amplify.yml` for the static kind, env vars) live in Papyrus as the template. The publication repo consumes that pattern; it does not invent a private one.

Do **not** edit `lib/site-brand.ts` / renderer dispatch in this issue if PPY-eca592 / PPY-a10206 are still in flight on those files. Record the intended `HostingConfig` shape in the doc so eca592 can absorb it as a sibling of `RendererConfig` rather than a second independent enum. Do not add a required-but-ignored field.

## Pilobil.us is the proof, not the product

1. Create Route 53 public hosted zone **pilobil.us** (doctrine spelling; repo is `Pilobol.us`). Comment NS records here for Ryan. Do this first so propagation runs in parallel.
2. Stand up Amplify Hosting **platform `WEB`** using the Papyrus-documented static pattern. Build = Markus static output (`web/dist` or the Papyrus-defined equivalent). Not `WEB_COMPUTE`, not `ampx pipeline-deploy`, not the Papyrus app `dbsyytcm9drqa`.
3. Attach `pilobil.us` + `www` once the zone exists. Amplify default domain is acceptable until NS propagate.
4. CI builds from repo-committed Markdown with `markus convert --allow-html` off.

## Constraints

- Do not fork Papyrus. Do not create a publication-specific Papyrus GitHub repo.
- Do not deploy to or modify p.apyr.us production.
- Do not touch `lib/renderer.ts` or `renderers/pretext/`.
- Record teardown for anything that is not the lasting hosted zone / production static app.
- Do not close this issue yourself.

## Acceptance

- Papyrus `docs/` (+ AGENTS.md pointer) describes hosting kinds so a later publication can choose `amplify-static` without copying Pilobil by folklore.
- Hosted zone exists; NS records are in a Kanbus comment.
- A push publishes Markus HTML to a reachable URL via the documented static option.
- After Ryan sets nameservers, `https://pilobil.us` serves that site.
